Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design on main 9f6508a (design 57cb9ae + AC-3 frozen-clock fix); impact analysis 6772b68 committed first; both promoted from pre-work drafts c6b5560/84ba733 on SPEC 4f247f4 (reviewed, unchanged). ADR-0015 and ADR-0019 amendments in 57cb9ae, before any code. Register row 1 verdict CONSISTENT, no condition (design-agent, 6fcb134, docs/review/06-client-identity/architecture-consistency.md). Shape: static public final web.ClientIdentity (not a bean: UrlshortApplicationTests boots web-application-type=none without ServerProperties); two separate questions, resolved client (clientOf, resolve sets CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE, of) for RateLimitFilter and ClickRecorder, direct peer (peerIsConnection, fromLoopback) for AuditController, which never reads the trusted list; bodies moved verbatim. Design section 5 is the one characterization matrix: dev2's 240b230 rows kept, remaining edges added (commit 1b, before the move), draft duplicates dropped; the lead's two conditions stated (existing unit assertions byte for byte; every row marked). Commit plan section 7: 240b230 + 1b tests, 2 production-only move with delegates, 3 re-point plus delegate deletion. Boot 4.1.1 valve trigger read in bytecode (hasText, same as the guard). No grant request.
